# winvd (vendored)

[VirtualDesktopAccessor](https://github.com/Ciantic/VirtualDesktopAccessor)'s Rust crate, version 0.0.49 from crates.io, MIT (see `LICENSE.txt`), by Jari Pennanen.

One change by EzDesk: a public `move_desktop` (in `src/desktop.rs` and `src/comobjects.rs`), to reorder desktops. Everything else is as published.
